hebrewText: וְ/עַל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֣י נָגִ֔יד אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן זִכְרִ֑י לַ/שִּׁ֨מְעוֹנִ֔י שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ בֶּֽן מַעֲכָֽה

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.explanation: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.explanationEn: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben

tokens.bdb: a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes
tokens.kjv: captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

tokens.bdb: Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites
a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

tokens.bdb: Zicri, the name of twelve Israelites
a Shimonite (collectively) or descendants of Shimon
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Shimonite  or descendants of Shimon
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Shimonite  or descendants of Shimon
tokens.explanation: a Shimonite  or descendants of Shimon

tokens.bdb: Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman
tokens.kjv: Maachah, Maachathites. See also H1038 (בֵּית מַעֲכָה).
